title: OpenZeppelin ReentrancyGuard
description: A public Solidity reentrancy-defense pattern from OpenZeppelin Contracts.
explanation: The nonReentrant modifier rejects nested state-changing entry before and after the guarded call.
remediation: Use checks-effects-interactions and a reentrancy guard for state-changing external calls.

title: SWC-128: DoS With Block Gas Limit
description: Unbounded loops over user-controlled arrays can exceed the block gas limit and make contract functions unusable.
explanation: Work that grows with an unknown-size array can consume more gas than a block allows.
remediation: Avoid unbounded loops; use pagination, pull-over-push, or bounded batches.
